versions.changelog:
- Switched procedure and documentation from Cargo CDK (`cdk`) to Cargo Project (`project`) commands for install and deploy steps.
- Updated instructions and terminology in SKILL.md to reflect usage with general Cargo projects, not just CDK projects.
- Removed the redundant skill-card.md file.
- Corrected and clarified project structure and integration steps in all documentation.
- No changes to core skill logic or functionality.

- Updated metadata: bumped version to 0.1.1.
- Documentation cleanup: improved and clarified content in SKILL.md and README.md.
- Removed deprecated file: skill-card.md has been deleted.

Initial release of visitor-identification skill.

- Identify which companies visit your website and what pages they read, using Snitcher integration.
- Maintains two Cargo models: one for visiting companies and another for their sessions, both kept current automatically.
- Ensures privacy by only loading the tracking script after visitor consent is given.
- Designed for company-level identification only (no individuals); integrates with existing Cargo Hosting sites.
- Includes guidance for installation, integration with current projects, and describes required inputs and consent handling.
